Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: genuine production champion portrait and its separate specialty object for a Heroes of Might and Magic III expansion, Zaun. Independently draw the subject; do not copy official character artwork.

Composition: landscape 1536 x 1024 image with TWO PANELS of ONE CHAMPION IDENTITY. LEFT two thirds x 0-1023: square close head-and-shoulders portrait, full head centered near x 512, top near y 60 and chin near y 730. RIGHT third x 1024-1535: one fully visible specialty OBJECT, centered within x 1070-1490, y 230-820, on a plain dark brown background. Straight vertical panel boundary x 1024. The specialty must not be a head, portrait crop, emblem or MOBA ability splash. No unrelated heroes, text, labels, frames or watermark.

Style: original 1999 Heroes III sculpted pre-rendered miniature portraits with a restrained oil-painted finishing pass. Strong three-dimensional facial/creature planes, rich tactile materials, directional upper-left light, crisp restrained eye highlights, readable silhouette. Natural anatomy, compact faces, rough cloth, worn leather, tarnished iron and brass. Background is real subordinate painted scenery with value separation. Must read at 58 x 64 and 48 x 32, with object readable at 44 x 44 and 32 x 32. No anime, mascot face, storybook softness, glossy modern 3D, modern splash-art layout, neon, flat vector, comic outline, mobile-game proportions, arbitrary pixel filter or painted text.

Champion: TWITCH.
Portrait: A mutated upright RAT of Zaun: long gray-brown rat muzzle, broad thin rounded pinkish ears, whiskers, yellow incisors, sharp wary small yellow eyes, shaggy cheek fur, coarse patched leather scavenger hood drawn back from ears. No human nose, beard or human skin. Head looks slightly right and upward, suspicious sly expression. Damp sewer brick and iron pipe background, muted cold teal light and an amber grate behind silhouette. Rat anatomy, not a cute mouse mascot.
Specialty object: One single short rusted crossbow bolt with a heavy green-amber reagent head and a large steel penetrating point, laid diagonally; no skull, no green flame, no head portrait.
